messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] No milestone data found for part(s) 1. Run this/these first before running part 2.
parts:
Hi Mohammadreza,

Most likely you are not using the same file path between both GGIR calls.
Note that metadatadir is not a parameter you can use in a GGIR-call, it is only used internally by GGIR itself. It is important that you provide outputdir and datadir consistently, because only then GGIR knows where to find the milestone data it previously generated.

When you use GGIR() with mode =1:5 you also will get the part 1 output. I do not understand why you would want to split the function. You now risk using inconsistent parameters values between the two GGIR calls, which will confuse GGIR and may lead to unexpected behaviour.

Best,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/


On Thursday, 19 December 2024 at 4:07 PM, Mohammadreza Sedghi <mohammadrez...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,
I am trying to use GGIR part 1 separately to yield the output and then use the output for the rest of the parts but I face with this error:
No milestone data found for part(s) 1. Run this/these first before running part 2. Can anyone please help me diagnose this issue and solve it? This is the part of the code I am using: GGIR(
mode = 1,
datadir = paste0(inputdir, "/", name),
outputdir = folder,
studyname = name, ## change the study name to the patient's ID
overwrite = FALSE,
idloc=2,
do.enmo = TRUE, do.anglez=TRUE,
chunksize=1,
printsummary=TRUE
) GGIR(
mode = c(2,3,4,5),
datadir = paste0(inputdir, "/", name),
metadatadir = ".../meta",
outputdir = destination,
studyname = study_name,
overwrite = FALSE,
idloc=2,
do.enmo = TRUE, do.anglez=TRUE,
chunksize=1,
printsummary=TRUE,

# Part 2:
strategy = 1,
ndayswindow=7,
hrs.del.start = 0,
hrs.del.end = 1,
maxdur = 8,
includedaycrit = daycrit,
winhr = c(5,10),
qlevels = c(0.95),
qwindow=c(0,7,17,24),
iglevels=1,
ilevels = c(seq(0,400,by=50),8000),

mvpathreshold =c(60,64),
bout.metric = 4,
closedbout=FALSE,
... ) Thank you in advance, Mohammadreza
